description.narrative: This one year core support project aims to strengthen Syrbanism’s institutional foundations and public visibility as the organization reestablishes its presence inside Syria following years of operating in exile. Syrbanism will use this grant to consolidate its internal systems, financial and governance procedures, and communication capacities, ensuring greater transparency, sustainability, and outreach. The project will prioritize five key areas: (1) developing internal financial and administrative systems; (2) enhancing communication and digital presence through a new bilingual website accessible inside Syria; (3) publishing and sharing Syrbanism’s extensive body of unpublished research on housing, informal settlements, and urban law; (4) conducting an internal staff workshop and organizational needs assessment to define strategic priorities; and (5) securing legal registration in Syria to enable full operational legitimacy and compliance. By the end of this project, Syrbanism will have established itself as a legally registered, well governed, and visible Syrian civil society organization capable of engaging with communities, local actors, and donors to advance inclusive and sustainable urban recovery.
